Darth Malgus Respect Thread — Comic Vine thread 1557966
URL: https://comicvine.gamespot.com/forums/gen-discussion-1/darth-malgus-respect-thread-1557966/
Research extraction (verbatim feat/evidence quotations where the thread supplied them). The thread pagination ends at post #68 on page 2. Poster rankings/opinions and non-cited matchup commentary are omitted. Cinematic/game feats without a supplied dialogue quote are identified as such rather than invented.

STATEMENTS / ACCOLADES (cited)

• “Malgus submitted utterly to the dark side, and doing so made him an exemplary warrior. His battlefield feats have never been duplicated.”
  Source named: Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side. (Statement/accolade.)

• “There in the hangars I encountered the most dangerous embodiment of the dark side I have ever experienced-the man who would later be known as Darth Malgus.”
  Source named: The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural. Statement by Satele Shan; direct comparison to every other dark-side embodiment she had experienced.

• “In his quest for domination, Darth Sidious tracked down what remained of five pivotal Sith texts written by his most powerful predecessors.”
  Source named: Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side: Official Synopsis. The post treats Malgus as one of the predecessors; the quoted line itself does not name him.

• “You returned to Grand Moff Regus to find him in a heated discussion with Darth Malgus, a member of the Dark Council.”
  Source named: The Old Republic: The Challenge of War.

• “While the undying Emperor serves as the unquestioned leader of the Empire, the twelve members of the Dark Council oversee the daily workings of their vast civilization and speak in the Emperor’s name. Each is among the most powerful Sith in the galaxy; to hold a seat on the council is the highest honor and the greatest position of influence a Sith can attain.”
  Source named: The Old Republic, Codex Entry: “The Dark Council.” Statement applied by the thread to Malgus’s council membership.

• “In the Emperor's absence, the galaxy's most domineering, powerful, brilliant, and cunning Sith lead the Empire's path to glory.”
  Source named: The Old Republic Encyclopedia. Statement about the Sith leaders in context of the council.

• “The Dark Council are the galaxy's most powerful Sith.”
  Source named: The Old Republic. Statement applied by the thread to Malgus’s council membership.

PHYSICAL / DURABILITY / SPEED (Deceived unless otherwise stated)

• “Malgus got his blade up in time, parried, and slammed a kick into the Jedi’s mid-section. The blow folded the Jedi in half, sent him reeling backward five paces.”
  Source: Deceived.

• “He parried the chop of a human male, leapt over the low slash of an orange-skinned Togruta female, severed the hand of the third, a female human, disarming her, then grabbed her by the throat with his free hand and slammed her into the floor with his Force-enhanced strength.”
  Source: Deceived. Scaling: this is a simultaneous three-Jedi engagement.

• “He ducked under a slash from the male, lunged forward, and took the Jedi by the throat. He lifted him from his feet and held him suspended in the air, gagging. The Jedi’s brown eyes showed no fear, but did show pain. Malgus roared, squeezed hard, then dropped the body and stood over it, blade at his side, breath coming hard.”
  Source: Deceived. Scaling: the same three-Jedi engagement; the male is killed by the throat squeeze.

• “Malgus spun into a high, Force-augmented kick that hit Zallow in the chest and sent him flying backward ten meters.”
  Source: Deceived. Scaling: Ven Zallow is identified in the thread as a Jedi Master and the opponent Malgus considered worthy of his attention.

• “He stepped to the doorway, drew on the Force, activated his lightsaber, and leapt out into the dark.” / “A ROAR, heavy with hate and rage, pulled Aryn’s eyes skyward. Malgus descended like a meteor. His cape flew out behind and over him, a comma of darkness, and he held his lightsaber in a two-handed grip. Power went before him in a wave of visible distortion. The shuttle out of which he had leapt flew off into the night sky.” / “Aryn fell fully into the Force, raised her defenses, took a fighting stance, and parried Malgus’s two-handed overhand slash. Still, he landed in a cocoon of power, hitting the ground in an explosion of might that shattered the stones around them and turned them into a hail of shrapnel.”
  Source: Deceived.

• “The force of the Sith’s blow made her arms quiver, but she gave no ground.”
  Source: Deceived. Scaling: Aryn Leneer.

• “She was unready for the blow. The Force-augmented impact exploded a spark shower in her brain and sent her cartwheeling away from Malgus; she slammed into a rock and landed on her side ten meters away. Adrenaline pulled her to her feet, though she swayed unsteadily. She spat a mouthful of blood and held both lightsabers at the ready.”
  Source: Deceived. Scaling: Aryn Leneer remains standing after the hit.

• “Malgus’s strength drove her to her knees.”
  Source: Deceived. Scaling: Aryn Leneer.

• “He pushed her blade to the side with his own and kicked her in the face. The strength behind the blow blew through her defenses, caused her to see stars, loosed teeth, and sent her head over heels backward. She landed on her knees, stunned, seeing double.”
  Source: Deceived. Scaling: Aryn Leneer.

• “He vented his rage in a continuous roar as he unleashed a furious series of blows: an overhand slash that Adraas parried; a low stab that Adraas barely sidestepped; a side kick that connected to Adraas's side, broke ribs, and flung Adraas fully across the narrow axis of the hall. He crashed into a column and the impact split it as would lightning a tree.”
  Source: Deceived. Scaling: Lord Adraas.

• “Adraas's trachea collapsed in Malgus's grip. There was no final cough or gag. Adraas died in silence.”
  Source: Deceived. Scaling: Malgus kills Adraas bare-handed after their duel.

• “In the hall outside, he slammed a fist down on the secretary’s desk, putting a crack on the marble top.”
  Source: Deceived.

• “Malgus loosed a furious series of overhand strikes that forced the Zabrak to retreat rapidly. Sidestepping a stab from the Jedi, Malgus rode his motion into a Force-augmented spinning side kick that hit the Jedi in the ribs and sent him cartwheeling into the wall of nearby building.”
  Source: The Third Lesson. Scaling: the Zabrak Jedi is defeated in the encounter.

• “Despite his wound, the Sith slapped aside Aryn’s Force-hold on the blade and snatched it out of the air, as quick as a sand viper.”
  Source: Deceived. Scaling: Aryn Leneer; Malgus is injured when he does this.

• “The red line of his weapon spun so fast in his hand it expanded into a shield.”
  Source: Deceived.

• “He closed the distance between them rapidly. The red line of Malgus's lightsaber moved so quickly it blurred into a red smear.”
  Source: The Third Lesson.

• “Malgus, nested deeply in the Force, perceived the dozens of bolts and their trajectory with perfect clarity. Without breaking stride he whipped his blade left, right, angled it ten degrees, and turned three bolts back on the soldiers who’d fired them, killing all three.”
  Source: Deceived.

• Cinematic feat as described by the thread (no dialogue quotation supplied): Malgus survives a missile blast, continues fighting Republic troopers, defeats Satele Shan, withstands a concussion grenade directly to the face, survives being thrown into a cliff by Satele (dislodging stone), and survives Satele’s Force blast that shatters the entire cliff. Source named by the post: The Old Republic “Return” cinematic / linked video https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=z0RuR3FREFw. Scaling: Satele Shan.

COMBAT SKILL / DUELS

• “Even before the Great War, Malgus was widely regarded as one of the greatest warriors in the Sith Empire.”
  Source: The Old Republic Encyclopedia. Statement.

• Cinematic feat as described (no supplied dialogue quote): as an apprentice, decades before his prime, Malgus defeats Satele; her master intervenes. Malgus and Vindican then duel Kao Cen Darach; Darach impales Vindican, after which enraged Malgus kills Darach. Source named: “The Old Republic” cinematic, linked https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mm4JEZudf0c. Scaling: Satele Shan, Vindican, Kao Cen Darach.

• Cinematic feat as described (no supplied dialogue quote): Malgus again holds the advantage over Satele; Jace Malcolm intervenes, enabling Satele to use Tutaminis-amped Force powers to defeat Malgus. Source: The Old Republic cinematic, linked https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=z0RuR3FREFw. Scaling: Satele Shan and Jace Malcolm.

• “He closed the distance between them rapidly. The red line of Malgus's lightsaber moved so quickly it blurred into a red smear. The Jedi parried again and again, the sizzle of blade on blade resounding through the ruins. Malgus's onslaught - a blizzard of slashes, cuts, and stabs - allowed the Jedi no room for a counterattack. The Jedi retreated before the offensive, desperately intercepting Malgus's blows.”
  Source: The Third Lesson.

• “Malgus loosed a furious series of overhand strikes that forced the Zabrak to retreat rapidly. Sidestepping a stab from the Jedi, Malgus rode his motion into a Force-augmented spinning side kick that hit the Jedi in the ribs and sent him cartwheeling into the wall of nearby building. At the same time, he reached out with the Force for the hidden light-side user, brushed aside the resistance he felt, and pulled the Jedi out of hiding.”
  Source: The Third Lesson.

• “A human male in his twenties rose up out of ruins, dangling like a fish on the hook of Malgus's power. His legs kicked futilely; the green blade of his lightsaber cut at empty air; he gagged as Malgus's power squeezed shut his throat.” / “So much for your ambush,” Malgus said, and closed his fist, crushing Vorin's windpipe.
  Source: The Third Lesson. Scaling: Malgus defeats the Zabrak and the hidden Jedi Vorin.

• “At 10 meters, Malgus extended his free hand and loosed veins of blue Force lightning. They struck the charging Jedi: swept through his defenses, swirled around him, and began to burn flesh. Shouting with pain, the Jedi leaned forward into the lightning ... One step, another, another, but he was failing, wilting in the heat of the lightning. Malgus channeled more power and the Jedi fell to his knees, screaming. The lightning spiraled around the Zabrak, blasting dark holes in his body. The lightsabers fell from his hands and he writhed in agony, screaming his pain into the sky.”
  Source: The Third Lesson. Scaling: the Zabrak Jedi is killed/ruined after the preceding duel.

• The thread describes a linked cinematic in which Malgus duels and defeats Ven Zallow in a fairly close fight. Source named: The Old Republic cinematic, https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wOLANti8UCY. Scaling: Jedi Master Ven Zallow.

• The thread quotes an extended Deceived duel with Aryn Leneer. Key verbatim evidence: “Still, he landed in a cocoon of power, hitting the ground in an explosion of might that shattered the stones around them and turned them into a hail of shrapnel.” Aryn “deflected them with the Force as she parried another slash”; Malgus’s blow made her arms quiver. Malgus later split an incoming large rock with his lightsaber; Aryn caught his kick and flung him twenty meters; Malgus intercepted her attack with Force lightning, which she blocked with two blades; she overcame it unharmed. Malgus then telekinetically shoved her into rock/rubble, pierced his own armor/side with Zallow’s green blade, struck her ten meters away, and snatched Zallow’s thrown lightsaber despite the wound. Source: Deceived. Scaling: Aryn Leneer and the dead Jedi Master Ven Zallow (whose lightsaber Aryn uses).

• Later Deceived duel: “Malgus’s strength drove her to her knees.” His lightning “exceeded anything she had felt from Malgus before,” blasted through her defenses, disarmed her, seized and lifted her, burned her flesh, and threw her from the shuttle; she blacked out. Source: Deceived. Scaling: Aryn Leneer.

• Extended Adraas duel evidence: “Malgus interposed his lightsaber, drew the lightning to it, and started walking toward Adraas. The power swirled around the red blade, sizzling, crackling, pushed against Malgus, but he strode through it. The skin of his hands blistered but Malgus endured the pain”; he returned the lightning, which “lifted [Adraas] bodily from the ground, and threw him hard against the far wall.” Later, “the power in his voice caused Adraas to wince”; Malgus stopped Adraas’s charge with lightning, blew away his lightsaber, burned him, severed his arm, Force-choked him, and then crushed his trachea by hand. Source: Deceived. Scaling: Lord Adraas.

• Linked game feat as described (no supplied dialogue quote): Malgus holds his own against strike teams of up to four; the possible teams include the Hero of Tython, Barsen’thor, Voidhound and Meteor, or Darth Nox, the second Emperor’s Wrath, Cipher Nine and the Grand Champion of the Great Hunt. The thread says Malgus chokes all but one at various points and duels members individually. Source named: The Old Republic game, https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zxBbBQsuq1Y. The post does not identify a canonical team. [panel: panels/malgus/malgus-telekinesis-1.gif; panels/malgus/malgus-telekinesis-2.gif; panels/malgus/malgus-lightning-1.gif]

• “Malgus's lightsaber form was flawless, but he let his anger and desperation cloud his fighting. He faltered, and I followed through.”
  Source: The Old Republic. Speaker is the Hero of Tython; direct scaling to Malgus’s lightsaber form.

TELEKINESIS

• “Malgus stood in a pocket under a mountain of rubble, legs bent, the power from his upraised hands preventing several tons of duracrete and steel from crushing him. Dust made his already troubled breathing more difficult. He coughed as the words of his father echoed in his mind.” / “Using the Force, he blew the rubble up and away from him. It fell with a crash into the adjacent buildings. A Force-augmented leap carried him out and over the heap.”
  Source: The Third Lesson. Scaling/context: severely injured and years before his prime; rubble came from two buildings.

• “At the same time, he reached out with the Force for the hidden light-side user, brushed aside the resistance he felt, and pulled the Jedi out of hiding.” / “His legs kicked futilely ... he gagged as Malgus's power squeezed shut his throat.”
  Source: The Third Lesson. Scaling: hidden Jedi Vorin.

• “Enraged by such cowardice, I hurled a boulder from the mountainside onto the path in front of us. I then slowly rolled it twenty paces ahead of our own progress, using focused mental energy channeled through the dark side.”
  Source: Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side.

• “The strength of my scream buckled the bridge's transparisteel viewport and left the crew's ears bleeding. More gratifyingly, my rage overloaded the fuel slugs of an incoming wave of Aureks. The bright bursts of their deaths raised a smile.”
  Source: Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side. Force Scream; affects a bridge viewport, crew, and incoming Aurek starfighters.

• “He crosscut the guard before him, putting a black canyon in his chest, continued the swing through the guard on his left, and with his left hand used a blast of power to drive the third guard into the Temple wall hard enough to crush bones and kill him.”
  Source: Deceived.

• “Malgus felt the sudden surge of terror in the two soldiers up on the ledge to his left, felt them take aim in sweaty hands, start to squeeze triggers. He flung his lightsaber at them, guided it with the Force in a flickering red arc that cut both of them down, then recalled the blade to his hand.”
  Source: Deceived.

• “Malgus drew on the Force and with a blast of power drove the Padawan across the hall and into one of the towering columns of stone, where she collapsed, blood leaking from her nose.”
  Source: Deceived.

• “Leaping high over the male’s cross-slash, Malgus landed behind the Togruta, who parried his lightsaber strike but could not defend herself against a Force blast that sent her skidding across the hall and into a pile of rubble.”
  Source: Deceived. Scaling: the Togruta Jedi in the three-Jedi engagement.

• “Another Jedi stepped in front of him, blue blade held high. Malgus barely saw him. He simply extended a hand, pushed through the Jedi’s insufficient defenses, seized his throat with the Force, and choked him to death. Tossing the body aside, he moved toward Zallow.”
  Source: Deceived. Scaling: the Jedi is killed while Malgus advances toward Ven Zallow.

• “Anger refilled him, overcame him. A shout of hate, raw and jagged, burst from his throat. Power went with it, shattering a nearby column and sending a rain of stone shards through the room.”
  Source: Deceived. Force Scream.

• “Malgus, burning with hate, flung his lightsaber at Zallow. He guided its trajectory with the Force, and it spun a sizzling path through the air at Zallow’s neck. But Zallow ... leapt into the air and over the blade. While Zallow was still in the air, Malgus unleashed a blast of energy that caught the Jedi unprepared and sent him crashing downward into a pile of rubble. He lay there, prone.”
  Source: Deceived. Scaling: Jedi Master Ven Zallow.

• “When the crowd did not respond to his demand, he slammed a fist into his palm and let anger-fueled power explode outward from his body. Screams sounded as the blast shoved everything away from him in all directions. Bodies flew backward, slammed into one another, into the walls, against and through windows. The transport he’d rode on lurched from the blast. The doors of the medical facility flew from their mounts and crashed to the ground.”
  Source: Deceived.

• “When she landed atop a large chunk of stone ten meters from the Sith, he made a cutting gesture with his free hand and two pieces of statuary rose from the rubble and rushed toward her from either side. She leapt into the air and they smashed into each other beneath her, spraying shards of rock.”
  Source: Deceived. Scaling: Aryn Leneer evades the attack.

• “Malgus bounced up from the somersault and loosed a telekinetic blast that lifted Aryn from her feet and blew her across the hangar. She slammed into one of the shuttle’s bulkheads, but used the Force to cushion the blow so that it did no harm.”
  Source: Deceived. Scaling: Aryn Leneer.

• “He drew on the Force, gestured as if he were shooing away insects, and sent both of the troopers flying against the wall of the manse hard enough to crack bone. Both sagged to the ground, unmoving.”
  Source: Deceived.

• “He reached out with the Force as Razor continued its rise, tried to take it in his mental grasp. Its ascent slowed. He held forth both of his arms, made claws of his hands, and shouted with frustration as he sought to hold back the power of the ship’s thrusters. He felt a tightness in his mind, the string of his power being drawn taut, stretching, stretching. He would not release the ship. Its thrusters began to whine. He held it, teeth gritted, sweat soaking his body, his breath a dry rattle through his respirator. And then the string snapped and the ship flew free, lifting clear of the roof doors.” [panel: panels/malgus/malgus-prior-final-duel-aryn-malgus-max-effort-1.jpg]
  Source: Deceived. Scaling: Dragonfly-class Imperial dropship; he delays but does not permanently stop takeoff.

• Linked game feat as described: Malgus telekinetically hurls the Jedi/Sith strike team; at various points chokes all but one. Source: The Old Republic, https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zxBbBQsuq1Y. The thread notes the lightning scene can depend on dialogue choice and the canonical team is unidentified.

LIGHTNING / OTHER FORCE POWERS

• “Malgus, not to be outdone, picked a Jedi Knight at random, a human female ten meters away, held forth his left hand, and discharged veins of blue lightning from his fingertips. The jagged lines of energy cut a swath through the battle, harvesting two Padawans as they went, until they caught up to the Jedi Knight and lifted her off her feet. She screamed as the lightning ripped into her, her flesh made temporarily translucent from the dark power coursing through her. Malgus savored her pain as she died.”
  Source: Deceived. Scaling: two Padawans and a Jedi Knight are killed.

• “As Aryn prepared to leap at Malgus, he held forth a hand, almost casually, and lightning sizzled through the space between them. Aryn interposed her lightsabers, but the power in the lightning exceeded anything she had felt from Malgus before. It blasted through her defenses and both lightsabers flew from her hands. The lightning seized her, lifted her up, and threw her from the top of the shuttle. As she flew toward the deck, she smelled burning flesh, heard screaming, realized that it was her flesh, her screams. She hit the ground hard and her head bounced off the ground. Sparks erupted in her brain, pain, and everything went dark.”
  Source: Deceived. Scaling: Aryn Leneer.

• “Malgus held forth his hand and the rage within him manifested in blue veins of lightning that discharged from his fingertips and slammed into Adraas. The power stopped Adraas's charge cold, blew his lightsaber from his hand, caught him up in a cage of burning lightning.” / “Adraas fell to the ground, his flesh smoking, the skin of his once handsome face blistered and peeling.”
  Source: Deceived (the thread misspells this source once as “Decevied”). Scaling: Lord Adraas.

• “At 10 meters, Malgus extended his free hand and loosed veins of blue Force lightning. They struck the charging Jedi: swept through his defenses, swirled around him, and began to burn flesh. ... Malgus channeled more power and the Jedi fell to his knees, screaming. The lightning spiraled around the Zabrak, blasting dark holes in his body. The lightsabers fell from his hands and he writhed in agony, screaming his pain into the sky. ... The Jedi, ruined, fell to the ground.”
  Source: The Third Lesson. Scaling: Zabrak Jedi.

• Linked cinematic feat as described: Malgus incapacitates Jace Malcolm with lightning at 1:58–2:00. Source: The Old Republic cinematic, https://www.youtube.com/watch?&v=z0RuR3FREFw. No dialogue quote supplied.

• Linked game feat as described: Malgus brings an entire strike team to its knees with Force Lightning. Possible team compositions named: Darth Nox, the Wrath, Cipher Nine and the Grand Champion of the Great Hunt; or Hero of Tython, Barsen’thor, Meteor and Voidhound. Source: The Old Republic, https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zxBbBQsuq1Y. The thread notes the scene can depend on the dialogue choice.

• The post says Malgus displays Force Maelstrom. No quotation or source passage is supplied in the original post. A later reply describes it as combining Barrier, telekinesis and lightning; the original post presents it under “Maelstrom” without a concrete quoted feat. [panel: panels/malgus/malgus-malgus-displays-force-maelstrom-1.jpg]

• “Emergency warning: Power core overrides engaged. Self-destruct initiated.”
  Source: The Old Republic. Context: Malgus overrides his space station’s power core with a gesture.

• “The blast will wipe out your fleet, and only I can deactivate the station's destruction cycle.”
  Source: The Old Republic. Statement by Malgus; establishes that only he can reverse the station’s self-destruct.

• “Malgus is filling [player]'s mind with visions of doubt!” / “The doubt weighs heavily on [player], they must face their destiny!”
  Source: The Old Republic. Telepathy/doubt effect on the player character.

• “He focused on keeping his Force signature suppressed. He did not want anyone to learn of his presence prematurely.”
  Source: Deceived. Force concealment.

FORCE SENSE

• “The presence of a light-side Force user bumped up against his Force sensitivity, a sudden flare in his perception.” / “He reached out through the Force, probing for the light-side presence he had felt.” / “There. He felt it as an irritation behind his eyes, an itch only violence could scratch.”
  Source: The Third Lesson. Scaling: he detects a hidden Jedi.

• “Leading the remaining troops up the mountain trail, a tremor in the Force echoed through me. The defenders of Ord Radama had placed mines on the path.”
  Source: Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side. He senses hidden mines.

• “I could do nothing to halt its fall into Ord Radama's gravitational pull. Minutes later, it impacted at the center of Livien Magnus. At that instant, I felt Venemal and a hundred thousand other life-forms roar with pain and then fall silent.”
  Source: Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side. Scaling: Darth Venemal and 100,000 other life-forms.

• “MALGUS FELT A FLASH of discomfort, the irritating needle stab of a light-side user, the feeling oddly similar to that which he had felt when he’d fought Master Zallow in the Temple. The feeling lasted barely an instant and disappeared, leaving only a sensory ghost in its wake.”
  Source: Deceived. Scaling: Aryn Leneer is the light-side user; direct comparison to sensing Master Zallow.

LATER THREAD ADDITIONS (posts #52–68)

• “Love your respect thread, but you forgot to add the fact that Malgus survived an explosion of an engine in the,\"Return\" cinematic trailer. He jumped headfirst into said engine; blowing it up with a lightsaber blade. The lightsaber blade itself is far too small to incacipate the engine, let alone protect Darth Malgus from the explosion. While Malgus leapt towards Darach, you can see that his rib armor is partially on fire.”
  Source named: Return cinematic trailer. This is a poster’s description of the visual feat; no additional dialogue quote is supplied.

• Three Jedi attack Malgus in the Deceived version of the Sacking of Coruscant. The supplied quote is: “Before he could locate the Jedi Master, three more Jedi swarmed him. He parried the chop of a human male, leapt over the low slash of an orange-skinned Togruta female, severed the hand of the third, a female human, disarming her, then grabbed her by the throat with his free hand and slammed her into the floor with his Force-enhanced strength.” / “Leaping high over the male’s cross-slash, Malgus landed behind the Togruta, who parried his lightsaber strike but could not defend herself against a Force blast that sent her skidding across the hall and into a pile of rubble.” / “He ducked under a slash from the male, lunged forward, and took the Jedi by the throat. He lifted him from his feet and held him suspended in the air, gagging. ... Malgus roared, squeezed hard, then dropped the body.”
  Source: Deceived. Scaling: Malgus defeats all three; one by bare hands, one by Force blast, and one by throat squeeze.

• “Malgus’s brewing anger boiled over into rage. He slammed his fists down on the worktable, denting it. He picked up a chair and threw it against the bulkhead, drove his fist through the small vidscreen built into the wall.”
  Source: Deceived.

• “Malgus thought 16-B was close to the launch doors he had seen open upon his arrival at the spaceport. He augmented his speed with the Force and blazed along the hall, leaving the soldiers far behind. The walls, signs, and floor were a blur to him as he sped toward the landing pad, toward Eleena.”
  Source: Deceived. Force-augmented speed.

• “Thinking of Eleena blew oxygen on the embers of his anger. In life, Eleena had been his weakness, a tool to be exploited by rivals. In death, she had become his strength, her memory the lens of his rage. He resided in the calm eye of a storm of hate. Power churned around him, within him. He did not feel as if he were drawing on the Force, using it. He felt as if he were the Force, as if he had merged with it. He had evolved. Nothing split his loyalties any longer. He served the Force and only the Force, and his understanding of it increased daily.”
  Source: Deceived. Statement of permanent power/understanding growth after Eleena’s death.

• “The blue disappeared in favor of the midnight of space, and she returned to normal perception. ... MALGUS FELT A FLASH of discomfort, the irritating needle stab of a light-side user, the feeling oddly similar to that which he had felt when he’d fought Master Zallow in the Temple. The feeling lasted barely an instant and disappeared, leaving only a sensory ghost in its wake.”
  Source: Deceived. Context supplied in the post: Aryn and Zeerid emerge from hyperspace in the Coruscant system; Malgus senses the light-side presence from the command chair of the capital ship Valor. The quote does not specify a numeric range.

• “After landing on Ilum, you struck the first blow against the Republic by slaughtering the Duros shocktroopers and their commander, Jedi Master Kaedan. You returned to Grand Moff Regus to find him in a heated discussion with Darth Malgus, a member of the Dark Council. Both men agreed that the next threat to be tackled are the Republic's Kaleesh mercenaries and their leader, General Gelrex.”
  Source named: Star Wars: The Old Republic, “The Challenge of War.” Statement/accolade: identifies Malgus as a Dark Council member; the slaughter is performed by the addressed player character, not Malgus.

• “I entered the battlefield and was immediately disheartened to realize that the Sith Lord Darth Malgus was leading the enemy forces. After our last confrontation over Korriban, I had dreaded the possibility of another confrontation with Malgus, and my life was nearly forfeit again on this occasion.”
  Source named: The Journal of Master Gnost Dural. Statement by Satele Shan; scaling: Malgus previously nearly cost her her life.

• “Malgus stormed the Republic defenses of Korriban at the start of the Great War, shattering the Republic army and crushing the defiant Jedi to reclaim the Sith homeworld. At the battle's glorious end, Malgus roared a battle cry that his impassioned army echoed, shaking the very cliffs of Korriban.”
  Source named: Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia. Scaling: Malgus, as an apprentice according to the post, shatters a Republic army and crushes the Jedi; the quote says the army’s echoed battle cry shook the cliffs.

• “In appearance, Zallow was everything Malgus—with his pale skin, scars, and hairless pate—was not. With respect to the Force, Malgus was everything Zallow was not.”
  Source: Deceived. Direct comparison: Malgus and Jedi Master Ven Zallow are opposites with respect to the Force.

• “As one, the seven Jedi moved toward Malgus and Eleena, and Malgus and Eleena moved toward them. More and more Padawans gathered on the balconies and walkways above, sparks of light-side blasphemy flickering in Malgus’s perception. The more powerful Force signatures of the approaching Jedi pressed against Malgus, and his against theirs, the power of each distorting the other by its presence. In his mind, the countdown continued. The space between him and the Jedi diminished. The power within him grew.”
  Source: Deceived. Scaling: Malgus’s Force signature matches/contests the combined presence of Ven Zallow plus six Jedi Knights before he releases his full power (the “seven Jedi” identification is the post’s connection).

• “When the Jedi Temple fell during the Sacking of Coruscant, only a handful of Council members perished in the violence.”
  Source named: Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia. The post’s scaling claim is that Zallow, as the only opponent Malgus considered worthy of attention, was above the council members present; that comparison is poster analysis, not stated in the quote.

• “No, I’m not hunting him. When I faced him I felt his hate, his rage.” She shuddered, wrapped her arms around her slim body. “It was like nothing I’d encountered in a Sith before. He lives in a dark place. And I … did not want to follow him there.”
  Source: Deceived. Statement by Aryn Leneer comparing Malgus’s hate/rage with every Sith she had previously encountered.

• “Memories floated up from the depths of his mind. He recalled his first pilgrimage to Korriban, remembered the profound sense of holiness he had felt as he walked in isolation through its rocky deserts, through the dusty canyons lined with the tombs of his ancient Sith forebears. He had felt the Force everywhere, had exulted in it, and in his isolation it had showed him a vision. He had seen systems in flames, the fall of a galaxy-spanning government. He had believed then, had known then and ever since, that the destruction of the Jedi and their Republic would fall to him.”
  Source: Deceived. Force vision; the post speculates it may foreshadow Palpatine’s rise/Order 66, but that speculation is omitted.

• “Power churned around him, within him. He did not feel as if he were drawing on the Force, using it. He felt as if he were the Force, as if he had merged with it. He had evolved. Nothing split his loyalties any longer.”
  Source: Deceived. Statement of power growth/evolution after killing Eleena.

• “He served the Force and only the Force, and his understanding of it increased daily.”
  Source: Deceived. Statement of continuing Force understanding.

• “What short memories you people have. Darth Malgus is the Empire's greatest hero. He led the assault on Coruscant's Jedi Temple. Killed its leaders.”
  Source named: Star Wars: The Old Republic, “Maelstrom Prison.” Statement/accolade; direct connection to the assault and killing the Temple’s leaders.
